title: feat(app-shell): the ban dialog says how many records the user holds and offers an optional hand-over
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuXPUtARb4DLwChKN8ZYkKGr)_

Fixes #30205

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：控制台「封禁用户」对话框在封禁原因上方多了一块：显示此人手上你能读到的记录数（总数、拥有、被指派，按对象和字段逐行），读不到的对象和被截断的统计如实写出；可选地选一位在职用户点「交接」，一次最多移交 500 条，结果显示已移交、失败（附每条原因）和剩余，剩余时可继续下一批。封禁按钮照旧，任何时候都能直接确认。
- 为什么改：#30205 的界面半。员工离职被封禁后，他名下的工单无人知晓、无人接手；服务器半（计数与批量转交接口）已由 PR #30546 落地，这里把它接到封禁对话框上。
- 风险与回滚：只改前端；面板只对平台自己的 `sys_user` 的 `ban_user` 动作出现，由宿主判定，不读任何作者元数据，其他动作的对话框不变。首屏英文语言包增加 374 B gz，超过该块的 60,000 上限，须排在 PR #30640 之后合并（那之后余量约 2.6 KB）。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/UserAssignedWorkPanel.tsx`（面板与交接流程）、`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/actionDialogCompanion.ts`（哪个对话框带面板）、`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ActionParamDialog.tsx` 的 companion 渲染处。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/ActionParamDialog.banAssignedWork-30205.test.tsx`，预期 12 个用例全绿（计数与拥有/指派拆分、读不到与截断、交接完成/部分失败/被拒、交接进行中仍可封禁）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地（须在 PR #30640 之后）。

## What changes

- **A host-composed companion on the param dialog.** `ParamDialogState` gains an optional `companion`, drawn at the top of the dialog's scrolling region. The host decides it from the platform action being run: the pure `resolveParamDialogCompanion(objectName, actionName, row)` (`views/actionDialogCompanion.ts`) answers `{ kind: 'user-assigned-work', userId }` for `ban_user` on `sys_user`, with the user id read from the row the action runs on, and nothing for any other action. No authored key selects it, so `sys-user.object.ts` and the spec are untouched. Both param-collection handlers, `useConsoleActionRuntime`'s and `RecordDetailView`'s, call that one function, so the two runtimes cannot drift.
- **`UserAssignedWorkPanel`** (app-shell internal, not exported). On open it calls `security.assignedWork.count(userId)` of `@objectstack/client` through the console adapter, as the signed-in administrator, and shows:
  - the total, **owned** (rows whose field is `owner_id`) and **assigned** (every other user field), then one row per object and field with its count, using the object's and field's translated labels;
  - `truncated` as a note that this person may hold more, `unreadable` as the named objects that were not counted, and `transferable: false` rows (multi-valued user fields) as counted but not handed over here;
  - a refused count inside the panel, without blocking anything.
- **The optional hand-over.** When some row is transferable, a `user` picker (the platform's person picker, which already leaves out banned users; the panel also leaves out the user being banned) and a Hand over button. One click is one `security.assignedWork.transfer(userId, { toUserId })` call (the server moves at most 500 rows). The report shows moved / could not be moved / still held, and each failed record's object, id and reason as the server worded it. When rows remain, the button reads "Hand over the next batch". The counts are read again after each hand-over, and the previous counts stay drawn until the new ones arrive. A target the server refuses as banned (`reference_user_banned`) is said in the reader's language; any other refusal shows the server's message.
- **The ban never waits.** The dialog's Confirm is still the ban. It stays enabled while a count or a hand-over runs, and after either fails.
- **Strings.** 19 `console.assignedWork.*` keys in all ten packs. `row` and `failure` are pure format strings and are added to `LEGITIMATE_IDENTITIES` in `untranslated-identity-4376.test.ts` with their reason.
- **Changeset.** `.changeset/ban-dialog-assigned-work-handover.md`, `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/i18n` patch.

Branch: the harness-assigned `claude/project-thread-4vnhy6`, not `claude/issue-30205-*`; the card is #30205.

## Tests

- New `views/actionDialogCompanion.test.ts` (5): the ban dialog gets the companion for its row (string and numeric ids); CONTROL, another `sys_user` action (`unban_user`, `set_password`) gets none; CONTROL, `ban_user` on another object or with no object gets none; a row with no id gets none.
- New `hooks/__tests__/useConsoleActionRuntime.banCompanion-30205.test.tsx` (2) and `views/RecordDetailView.banCompanion-30205.test.tsx` (2): each handler hands the dialog the companion for `ban_user` with `params._rowRecord`, and none for `unban_user`.
- New `views/ActionParamDialog.banAssignedWork-30205.test.tsx` (12), with the client's `count` / `transfer` as recording doubles: one count for the dialog's user and the owned/assigned split; `splitAssignedWork` counts only `owner_id` as owned; truncated and unreadable notes; nothing readable means no hand-over offered; a refused count keeps Confirm enabled and Confirm still resolves; the hand-over button waits for a pick; a complete hand-over reports and recounts; a partial hand-over names each failure and offers the next batch, which calls transfer again; a banned target is the translated sentence; another refusal shows the server's reason; Confirm stays enabled and bans while a hand-over is in flight; no panel and no count without the companion.
- `RecordDetailView.paramRuntimeParity-6431.test.tsx`: `companion` joins `DIALOG_READS`, since both runtimes now write it.
- **Ablations** (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, on committed `975b53ff`, each restored by the tool: blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty):
  - `useConsoleActionRuntime.tsx`, `companion: resolveParamDialogCompanion(...)` replaced by `companion: undefined`: its handler test went red, 1 failed / 2, `expected undefined to deeply equal { kind: 'user-assigned-work', … }`.
  - The same replacement in `RecordDetailView.tsx`: its handler test red, 1 failed / 2, same message.
  - `ActionParamDialog.tsx`, the companion render guarded off: the panel suite red, 10 failed / 12 (the two that stay green are the pure split and the no-companion case).

## Acceptance notes

- **Owned is 0 on most objects until #30646 lands.** The server's field list skips `system: true` fields, and the platform-injected `owner_id` is `system: true`, so only objects that declare `owner_id` themselves (in the showcase, `showcase_announcement`) count or move owned records. Measured on the live showcase: three `showcase_project` rows owned by the user were not counted. The panel shows the server's answer as it came and does not compute owned records itself; once the server counts the injected field, the owned figure appears with no change here.
- **What "owned" means here.** Only rows whose field is `owner_id` are owned; every other user field (an app's `assignee`, `f_user` in the showcase) is assigned.
- **Eager English pack.** `CI=true vite build` of the console, `dist/eager-closure.json`: `i18n-locale-en` 59,951 gz with `main`'s `en.ts` and 60,325 gz with this branch's, so +374 B, measured as two builds of the same tree that differ only in that file. That is over the chunk's 60,000 ceiling, and `pnpm --dir ui check:eager-closure` is red on this branch (`i18n-locale-en 58.9 KB / 58.6 KB ceiling (OVER by 0.3 KB)`). PR #30640 moves the marketplace strings out of the pack (59,951 → 57,010 at its head), so this PR lands after it: merge `main` once #30640 is in, rebuild, and the check clears with about 2.6 KB to spare. The ceiling is not raised here. The eager chunk count is 103 on both builds.
- **One hand-over per click.** The panel does not loop over batches by itself. A failed row still holds the user and is retried on the next call, so an automatic loop would count the same failures again; the administrator sees each batch's report and asks for the next.
- **A language switch** relabels the panel and does not recount.
- **Screenshots** (live showcase, console via vite at 1440 wide, 2x):
  - before, the ban dialog on `main` `14c67d44`, with the description and the ban reason only: [en](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/44ce98c65fa36cc386b4a1f2d4a14e3c0939f357/evidence/30205/before-ban-dialog-en-US-1440.png?raw=true), [zh-CN](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/44ce98c65fa36cc386b4a1f2d4a14e3c0939f357/evidence/30205/before-ban-dialog-zh-CN-1440.png?raw=true);
  - after, the dialog with the counts: [en](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/44ce98c65fa36cc386b4a1f2d4a14e3c0939f357/evidence/30205/after-1-ban-dialog-counts-en-US-1440.png?raw=true) (7 held: owns 3 on Announcement, assigned 2 on Field Zoo's single user field, plus 2 on its multi-valued field, marked not transferable), [zh-CN](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/44ce98c65fa36cc386b4a1f2d4a14e3c0939f357/evidence/30205/after-1-ban-dialog-counts-zh-CN-1440.png?raw=true) (a second user who owns 2);
  - after one hand-over to another user: [en](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/44ce98c65fa36cc386b4a1f2d4a14e3c0939f357/evidence/30205/after-2-handover-report-en-US-1440.png?raw=true) ("Handed over 5, 0 could not be moved, 0 still held", the recount leaving the 2 multi-valued rows), [zh-CN](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/44ce98c65fa36cc386b4a1f2d4a14e3c0939f357/evidence/30205/after-2-handover-report-zh-CN-1440.png?raw=true); the target user's own count then answered 3 owned announcements and 2 `f_user` rows;
  - after Confirm, the banned user's record page: [en](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/44ce98c65fa36cc386b4a1f2d4a14e3c0939f357/evidence/30205/after-3-banned-record-en-US-1440.png?raw=true), [zh-CN](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/44ce98c65fa36cc386b4a1f2d4a14e3c0939f357/evidence/30205/after-3-banned-record-zh-CN-1440.png?raw=true). No page error was recorded on any run.
  - Committed at `44ce98c6` and removed from the tree by the next commit.

## Verification

- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/i18n/ packages/app-shell/src/views/ActionParamDialog packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView packages/app-shell/src/hooks/__tests__/useConsoleActionRuntime packages/app-shell/src/views/actionDialogCompanion packages/app-shell/src/__tests__/` on `bbee3036`: 266 files, 2928 passed, 13 skipped, 1 failed (the partial hand-over case, which the next commit `3e306eff` fixed by keeping the previous counts drawn during the recount); that file on `3e306eff`: 12 / 12. The run includes every i18n suite walking the ten packs (key parity, untranslated identities) and the product-neutral renderer ratchet.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check` (source and tests): exit 0 on `bbee3036`; the last source commit changes one statement.
- eslint `--no-inline-config` on `UserAssignedWorkPanel.tsx`, `userAssignedWork.ts`, `actionDialogCompanion.ts`: 0 problems. On the edited `ActionParamDialog.tsx`: 0 errors, its existing warnings only.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`: 35 derived families, the same list at `fb246487` and `bfe597f0`. All 35 exit 0 on `bfe597f0`, including `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` (170 files passed, 2 skipped; 4970 tests passed). `--ran` reconciles 35 derived, 35 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
- Outside the derived list, on `bfe597f0`: `pnpm --dir ui run check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-dead-keys`, `check:eager-locale-catalogues`, `check:new-line-citations` exit 0. `pnpm --dir ui check:eager-closure` exit 1, `i18n-locale-en` over its ceiling by 0.3 KB, as the Acceptance notes say: it clears once #30640 is merged in.
